Register Now About Ho Ho 5K The Ho Ho 5K is a holiday 5K run and walk hosted by X-Dog Adventures at Cook Park, 17005 SW 92nd Ave, Portland, OR. Holiday costumes are encouraged, and friendly dogs are welcome. Every finisher gets Hostess HoHos and Sno Balls, and there are free trees and, yes, the fruitcake. Bring warm clothes to change into for the post-race festivities. The race also collects canned food, jackets and blankets, and cat and dog food for the humane society, so bring a donation if you can. Late registration and bib pickup open at 8 AM on race morning. Register Now About Silver Falls Trail Challenge If you have never been to Silver Falls State Park, you are in for a treat. There just ARE NOT ENOUGH ADJECTIVES to describe the PNW brand of beauty and mystique that is personified by Silver Falls State Park. The chance to run behind and pass these picturesque falls is something you won ' t soon forget. Silver Falls is truly one of the most epic places in the PNW. Register Now About White River Snow Shoe The White River Snow Shoe race is X-Dog Adventures ' winter snowshoe race on Mt. Hood. It starts and finishes at White River West Sno-Park, between Government Camp and Mt. Hood Meadows on Highway 35. Choose the 4K, one loop through the upper White River canyon, or the 8K, two loops of the same course. After the race there are warm snacks and drinks, medals and awards, and X-Dog raffles. The awards ceremony follows right after the race, weather and conditions permitting. Bring a change of clothes. Need snowshoes? Local shops have offered rental deals through the race ' s sponsors; check the registration page for this year ' s offers. Title: Crown Stub 100 in Buxton, OR | WHY RACING EVENTS
Meta description: Crown Stub 100 (100 Mile) in Buxton, OR on Saturday, April 24, 2027. Registration, course details and race day info.
H1: Crown Stub 100

Crown Stub 100 in Buxton, OR | WHY RACING EVENTS Skip to main content Races Training Volunteer Give Back Community Travel Sponsors About Corporate Wellness Find My Race Home Races Training Volunteer Give Back Community Travel Sponsors About Corporate Wellness Find My Race Home › Events › Crown Stub 100 Crown Stub 100 Crown Stub 100 is a 100 Mile running event in Buxton, OR on Saturday, April 24, 2027, hosted by Bivouac Racing. Register Now About Crown Stub 100 Crown Stub 100 is Bivouac Racing ' s 100-mile ultramarathon based at Stub Stewart State Park near Buxton, Oregon, with over 7,000 feet of climbing. The course is a double out-and-back from the park. The first leg heads north on the Banks-Vernonia State Trail, around Vernonia Lake, then east on the Crown Zellerbach Trail for roughly 20 miles, turning before Scappoose. After passing back through the park, runners head about 10 miles south on the Banks-Vernonia Trail to Banks and back, then finish with one 6.5-mile loop of the Stub Stewart Trail Challenge course. The finish line is at the Hilltop Day Use Area. Expect mostly asphalt on the Banks-Vernonia Trail, mostly hard-packed gravel on the Crown Zellerbach Trail, and about 10 percent dirt trail inside the park. 100-mile finishers earn a buckle. The Royal Ultra Relay splits the distance between teams of two who trade off at exchange points, with awards for the most creative team names and costumes.
